{
 "path": "programs/task-1e3812bd.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Identify rectangular monochrome outlines and fill their interior. The fill color
    # is 2 for color-3 frames, otherwise 7.
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    for c in colors:
        pts = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x] == c]
        if not pts: continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,x in pts), max(r for r,x in pts)
        x0, x1 = min(x for r,x in pts), max(x for r,x in pts)
        # Frames may be multiple disconnected objects of same color: examine bbox components.
        seen=set()
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            stack=[p]; seen.add(p); comp=[]
            while stack:
                r,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,x))
                for q in ((r-1,x),(r+1,x),(r,x-1),(r,x+1)):
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==c:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            a,b=min(r for r,x in comp),max(r for r,x in comp)
            d,e=min(x for r,x in comp),max(x for r,x in comp)
            if len(comp) != 2*(b-a+1)+2*(e-d+1)-4: continue
            if b-a<2 or e-d<2: continue
            fill = 2 if c==3 else 7
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                for x in range(d+1,e):
                    if grid[r][x] == bg: out[r][x]=fill
    return out
"
}
